mapper.select: SELECT TOP 20 username, action_type AS actionType, description, request_uri AS requestUri, status_code AS statusCode, created_at AS createdAt FROM operation_logs WHERE status_code >= 400 ORDER BY created_at DESC

SELECT TOP 20 uuid, file_name AS fileName, supplier_guid AS supplierGuid, last_import_error AS lastImportError, upload_date AS uploadDate FROM import_attachments WHERE import_status = 0 ORDER BY upload_date DESC

SELECT TOP 20 id AS runId, matched_count AS matchedCount, applied_count AS appliedCount, skipped_count AS skippedCount, rollback_of_run_id AS rollbackOfRunId, remark, created_at AS createdAt FROM retail_price_sync_runs WHERE skipped_count > 0 OR rollback_of_run_id IS NOT NULL OR applied_count = 0 ORDER BY created_at DESC
